title: TIDE: Reclaiming Lost Performance In On-Policy Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2611.17924v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Synchronous, colocated RL post-training of large language models (LLMs) today suffers from severe under-utilization due to long-tail rollouts. Inference engines fall idle waiting for long-tail rollouts or decode at low, inefficient batch sizes. To address this, we present TIDE, an RL training system that preserves on-policy training semantics while recovering resource utilization. TIDE does so by two complementary techniques: (1) dynamically repurposing rollout GPUs for training while long-tail rollouts complete and (2) dynamically migrating rollouts between inference engines to boost decoding throughput. TIDE automatically determines the right time to repurpose rollout resources through an adaptive migration policy, obtaining performance improvements that generalize across multiple applications and hardware configurations without requiring bespoke configuration. translated_title: TIDE：重拾在策略强化学习中损失的性能
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.17924v1 公告类型： new 摘要：当前，大型语言模型（LLM）的同步共置式强化学习（RL）后训练由于长尾推演的存在而遭受严重的资源利用率不足问题。推理引擎要么在等待长尾推演完成时处于空闲状态，要么以较低且低效的批量大小进行解码。为解决这一问题，我们提出了TIDE——一个在保持在策略训练语义的同时恢复资源利用率的强化学习训练系统。TIDE通过两项互补技术实现这一目标：（1）在长尾推演完成期间，动态地将用于推演的GPU重新分配用于训练；（2）在推理引擎之间动态迁移推演任务以提升解码吞吐量。TIDE通过自适应迁移策略自动确定重新利用推演资源的最佳时机，所获得的性能提升能够泛化至多种应用和硬件配置，而无需定制化配置。在我们的评估中，TIDE实现了高达1.36倍的端到端加速。
tldr: TIDE通过动态复用空闲推演GPU进行训练以及在推理引擎之间迁移推演任务，在保持在策略训练语义的前提下，将LLM强化学习后训练的端到端性能提升高达1.36倍。
en_tdlr: TIDE reclaims lost performance in on-policy RL post-training of LLMs by dynamically repurposing rollout GPUs for training and migrating rollouts across inference engines, achieving up to 1.36x end-to-end speedup while preserving on-policy training semantics.
